column1: # The CI gate's baseline (ADR-0014, section 4, "Regressions"): for each
# workload, Rust's time over Go's in the bench ledger's first entry
# a session's ratio is more than twice its baseline. Lower a value when a
# ledger entry records a lasting gain; never raise one to make a red gate
# green without a ledger entry that explains why.
# Left out: the memory-bound derivations (snacl.derive, kdf.*), whose ratio
# depends on the runner's memory system and core count, and mix.*, whose
# Go side needs FLINT, which CI's runner does not have.
